findings.claim: The plan schedules plaintext node publishes and a plaintext Obsidian release even though the phase goal requires client-side encryption before content reaches the node.
findings.evidence: Goal: "client-side encryption before content reaches the node: content, paths and manifest encrypted". Plan change 5 says: "Release 1 scope note: plaintext format on test vaults only. The release notes state that content is public by CID until release 2." The trade-off section also says: "T1 (revised): release 1 is plaintext. It ships before encryption".
findings.suggested_fix: Move encryption before any publish/release that writes vault content to the shared node, or constrain all pre-encryption operations to a local/mock Kubo node and make the first shared-node Obsidian release encrypted.

findings.claim: The configurable publication key can cause name/publish to an existing key not created by this project, violating the shared-node constraint.
findings.evidence: Constraint: "Never key/rm, pin/rm, or name/publish to keys you did not create" and "All node mutations must target paths/keys created by this project". Plan mvp-01 defines "publicationKey, the IPNS key name, created with `key/gen` only when absent" and later mvp-02 performs "name/publish ... to `publicationKey`". If the configured name already exists but belongs to another project, the plan would publish to it rather than creating a project-owned key.
findings.suggested_fix: Require publication keys to be created and recorded by this project before use, enforce a project-specific prefix/registry, and refuse name/publish when the key exists but lacks project ownership metadata.

findings.claim: The configurable MFS root allows destructive writes/removes outside `/obsidian-vault-sync/*`, violating the node safety constraint.
findings.evidence: Constraint: "No key/rm, pin/rm, or files/rm outside /obsidian-vault-sync/* on the shared node". Plan mvp-01 defines "mfsRoot, default `/obsidian-vault-sync`" but does not require validation, and its status operation performs "files/write → files/stat → files/rm under `<mfsRoot>/.probe/`". Later sync changes also write/remove under `<mfsRoot>/current/`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an acceptance requirement that all shared-node mutations validate `mfsRoot` is under `/obsidian-vault-sync/<project-owned-name>/` before any `files/write`, `files/rm`, `pin/add`, or cleanup operation; fail closed otherwise.
